Name: Kingdom Hearts Bedspreads
Author: AiyexAyen
Description:
[size=3][b]Kingdom Hearts Bedspreads[/b] is a content pack for Alternative Textures that adds a selection of Kingdom Hearts themed coverlets to use with the standard double bed. Now your farmer can collect the kind of merch you wish existed in real life.[/size]


[size=4][u][b]Notes
[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*]2.0.0 version is here! Updated for Stardew 1.6 compatibility.
[*]Mod no longer uses Content Patcher to patch in the bedspreads, but adds them in as entire bed textures via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ framework.
[*]Has options that include alternative bed frame colours to match the bedspreads.
[*]Requires the first house upgrade at minimum to obtain the double bed.
[*]Requires the Paint Bucket tool sold at Robin's to access the alternative double bed texture library.
[*]Check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21334]Kingdom Hearts Shirts[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21335]Kingdom Hearts Hairstyles[/url]﻿ mods for some cosplay to match your new bed!
[/list]
[size=4][u][b]How To Install:[/b][/u][/size]

1. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ is installed and updated to the latest version.
2. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] is installed and updated to the latest version.
3. Download the Kingdom Hearts Bedspreads .zip file.
4. Unzip and add folder to your Mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Compatible with the 1.6 update! Mod has been converted to use the Alternative Textures framework, and several bed frame options have been added for each bedspread.
